system.name: Dropshipping · studio reference
system.description: Demo-only single Worker, bundled storefront/admin, D1, R2 and hosted checkout. Durable orders and integrations remain C4b; scaffold is not the completed product. Guest checkout has no customer accounts.

nodes.name: Guest shopper
nodes.description: Browses and looks up an order by number/email; no customer account.

nodes.name: Store operator
nodes.description: Handles authorized administration and assisted fulfillment.

nodes.name: Stripe hosted checkout
nodes.description: Hosted payment provider; no custom card flow.

nodes.name: Cloudflare Workflows
nodes.description: Managed orchestration bound to the same Worker; no queue equivalence.

nodes.name: Email delivery
nodes.description: Cloudflare EmailSender integration with documented fallback.

nodes.name: Vendor adapters
nodes.description: Future assisted/mock/API integrations; API access unverified.

elements.name: Storefront browser
elements.description: Guest browse, cart and status-page assets bundled into the same Worker deployment.

elements.name: Admin browser
elements.description: Separate back-office bundle served by the same Worker; operator Access verification remains C4b.

elements.name: Storefront Worker
elements.description: One Cloudflare Worker serves every demo brand and both browser bundles; API, cron and workflow class stay in this deployment.

elements.name: D1 catalog and orders
elements.description: Documented D1 authority. Scaffold has no application tables; schema and business behavior remain future work.

elements.name: R2 media
elements.description: Documented R2 product/brand bytes. Private foundation does not promise public delivery/signing integration.

elements.name: Stripe hosted checkout
elements.description: External hosted checkout and signed payment events. Card data never touches application code.

elements.name: Cloudflare Workflows
elements.description: Managed durable orchestration capability bound to the same Worker class, not an independent application or message queue. OrderWorkflow is a scaffold stub.

elements.name: Cloudflare Email Sending
elements.description: Documented email binding behind EmailSender; Resend fallback remains source integration work.

elements.name: Cloudflare Access
elements.description: Operator admin access boundary only. Guest shoppers have no customer accounts.

elements.name: Vendor adapter boundary
elements.description: Future mock/assisted/API adapters. No vendor API credentials, permissions, availability or unattended purchases are assumed.
